standard_prerequisites.use: Upgrades the comparison map to an isomorphism.

core_obligations: Set-up: the extended maximal ideal is the maximal ideal of the target because the quotient is a field, and the two residue fields are identified (proof lines 1068-1071)
Map between the hulls: the hull over the target is injective over the source, and the identification of residue fields extends to a map from the source hull into it (proof lines 1072-1074)
Isomorphism: the map becomes an isomorphism on the quotients by all powers of the maximal ideal, so the criterion for injective hulls applies (proof lines 1075-1079)
proof_roadmap: m_R S = m_S（因为其商是域），记 κ = R/m_R = S/m_S。
由「平坦时内射性保持」引理，E_S 是在 R 上内射的；把剩余域的同构延拓为 R-模映射 E_R → E_S。
由「幂商同构」判据（R/m_R^n ≅ S/m_S^n 对一切 n）得该映射是同构，即两者都是 κ 的内射壳。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a flat local homomorphism inducing an isomorphism on residue fields the injective hull of the residue field of the source is also the injective hull over the target (author lemma at source lines 1060-1066, label lemma-compare). The proof (source lines 1068-1080) identifies the residue fields, uses flatness to make the target hull injective over the source, extends the identification to a map between the hulls and shows it is an isomorphism through the criterion on quotients by powers of the maximal ideal (proof lines 1068-1079). The comparison through the power quotients is the substance. H3.
